title: Add RAG Callflow Annotator guide and contract-sandbox examples
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: customers and internal teams asked for a compact, opinionated authoring flow to inspect and debug multi-tool RAG call sequences (tool calls, fallback logic, and contract mismatches). This PR introduces the 'RAG Callflow Annotator' doc + a lightweight contract-sandbox quickstart that demonstrates typed tool contracts, inline annotations, and telemetry probes. Motivation: improve onboarding for tool-calling scenarios and make it trivial to author deterministic step-by-step repros for regressions. What this changes: adds a new docs guide (docs/guides/rag-callflow-annotator.md) that walks through annotating a conversation, identifying tool-call boundaries, and mapping contract expectations; a quickstart (examples/callflow-sandbox/) with TypeScript and Rust/wasm adapter examples, sample contract JSON schemas, a small local dev server to replay annotated sessions, authoring templates for the docs site (frontmatter + live-snippet refs), and a set of test scenarios used by existing smoke CI. Implementation notes: the quickstart contains a small adapter shim (examples/callflow-sandbox/adapter-ts/) that shows how to expose tool metadata to Redwood's runtime and emit structured telemetry events; the Rust/wasm adapter (examples/callflow-sandbox/adapter-wasm/) demonstrates embedding lightweight validators for contract enforcement. The docs page includes a diagnostic section describing how to interpret telemetry traces, how to configure step checkpoints for replay, and recommended rollbacks for common contract drift patterns. Backwards compatibility: all examples are opt-in; no changes to runtime or public API. Testing: added smoke tests and a small playwright-based walkthrough (ci/playwright/callflow.spec.ts) that validates the end-to-end replay. Checklist: - [x] Author guide draft and examples - [x] Working adapters (TS + WASM) - [x] CI smoke + playwright test - [x] TOC and nav integration - [x] Release notes entry drafted in docs/release-notes/ - [x] UX screenshot assets included Follow-ups: (1) integrate the annotator into the authoring studio (separate PR), (2) add a server-side replay harness into the eval-harness repo for larger corpora. Related: ENG-4512 tracking instrumentation work; SUP-1124 support ticket that surfaced the need.
